    Import a qupflowR handoff or neutral interchange file

    Source: R/interop-handoff.R
    at_import_qupflowr.Rd

    Read only the neutral contract, validate it, and return a namespaced hyperannotatR result together with a conversion report. For a handoff directory the SHA-256 inventory (missing, extra, duplicate, resized, altered or symlinked files), the manifest schema and major version, ROI id uniqueness and the id join between manifest and GeoJSON, layers, planes, mask dimensions, integer values and legend completeness are all checked. Every file the manifest references must be a clean relative path listed in the verified inventory; unlisted operating-system metadata files (.DS_Store, ._*, Thumbs.db, desktop.ini) are ignored with a warning. Any failure aborts with a classified at_error: at_validation_error for integrity, schema and join failures, at_protocol_error for an unsupported major version, at_limit_error for oversized inventories and at_io_error for missing files. Nothing is written, no analysis is started, and foreign objects are never returned as if they were hyperannotatR objects: imported ROIs carry source = "imported" and partner fields under attributes$qupflowr. Features of a single GeoJSON file that carry no id get a minted one and are flagged (attributes$qupflowr$id_minted), so at_stage_qupflowr() creates them instead of joining them to an existing ROI; two features with the same id are refused (DUPLICATE_ID). Handoff coordinates are read at the export level recorded in the manifest. An RDS file is refused, because deserialising it is not a neutral read.

    Usage

    at_import_qupflowr(
  file,
  format = c("auto", "handoff", "qupath_geojson", "geojson", "mask", "npy"),
  expected_revision = NULL,
  call = rlang::caller_env()
)

    Arguments

    file

    A handoff directory (or its manifest.json/integrity.json), a QuPath GeoJSON, a GeoJSON, a mask TIFF/PNG with legend sidecar, or a .npy mask.

    format

    "auto" (default), "handoff", "qupath_geojson", "geojson", "mask" or "npy".

    expected_revision

    Optional "sha256:..." annotation revision the caller expects the handoff to carry; a different revision aborts with an at_conflict_error (REVISION_CONFLICT).

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    An at_import_report: a list with status, format, source_name, handoff_digest, manifest, checks (tibble of check, status, detail), objects (layers: named list of annot_layer; masks: named list of annot_mask; images: image records), conversion (tibble with one row per ROI: roi_id, layer, label, source_object_id, object_type, geometry_fidelity, geometry_match ("exact" bytes, "equivalent" within 1e-9 after level normalisation, "changed", or NA without a manifest record), notes) and annotation_revision of the imported layers.

    See also

    at_export_qupflowr(), at_stage_qupflowr()

    Other interop: at_annotation_revision(), at_commit_qupflowr(), at_export_qupflowr(), at_interop_capabilities(), at_interop_manifest(), at_stage_qupflowr()

    Examples

    dest <- file.path(tempdir(), "handoff-import-example")
at_export_qupflowr(at_example_project(), dest, overwrite = TRUE)
rep <- at_import_qupflowr(dest)
rep$checks
#> # A tibble: 4 × 3
#>   check               status detail                                            
#>   <chr>               <chr>  <chr>                                             
#> 1 integrity           ok     5 files verified                                  
#> 2 manifest_schema     ok     1.1                                               
#> 3 annotations:project ok     3 ROIs joined by id at level 0                    
#> 4 masks               ok     1 masks: dimensions, integers and legends verified
